name: Akamine Mirei
source:
A beautiful girl who fights with the power of fire and has a fierce personality underneath her good looks.
Even during her school life, she goes to the kendo club and trains hard in order to practice fighting against the evil organization.
Before she was a girl of her age, and was a bit of a loner who turned away from romance. That is, until she encountered the protagonist's big dick.
